itemDisplayName: Govern Microsoft Foundry agents, models, tools and egress with Azure Policy
description: Assigns Microsoft Foundry built-in Azure Policy controls for agent kinds, hosted-agent container images, hosted-agent egress (and the RAI policies that define it), model deployments, toolbox and prompt-agent tools, and agent prompt content filtering at subscription, resource group or Foundry resource scope, individually or as one custom initiative.
summary: Foundry governance as code: built-in Azure Policy assignments for agents, models, tools, egress and agent safety.
